data: Rattrapé par ses souvenirs d’enfance, un adolescent constate le fossé affectif qui le sépare de sa mère qui n’a jamais exprimé de marque d’affection envers lui. Plus proche de son père, il craint sa propre mère qu’il juge responsable du climat orageux au sein de sa famille. Il va progressivement se rendre compte que ses parents ne sont pas tout à fait ceux qu’il imaginait. (Caught up in his childhood memories, a young teenager is faced with an emotional gulf that separates him from his mother, who has never shown any affection toward him. Closer to his father, he fears his mother, whom he holds responsible for their stormy home life. Gradually, he will come to realize that his parents are not quite the people he thought they were.)

Rattrapé par ses souvenirs d’enfance, un adolescent constate le fossé affectif qui le sépare de sa mère qui n’a jamais exprimé de marque d’affection envers lui. Plus proche de son père, il craint sa propre mère qu’il juge responsable du climat orageux au sein de sa famille. Il va progressivement se rendre compte que ses parents ne sont pas tout à fait ceux qu’il imaginait.

Caught up in his childhood memories, a young teenager is faced with an emotional gulf that separates him from his mother, who has never shown any affection toward him. Closer to his father, he fears his mother, whom he holds responsible for their stormy home life. Gradually, he will come to realize that his parents are not quite the people he thought they were.
